---

Welcome to m2, the ultimate modern utility suite designed to give you total control over the server. Built on the sleek, ultra-responsive Rayfield GUI, m2 combines high-performance combat assistance with dynamic player manipulation—all wrapped in a clean, highly configurable layout.

Whether you're looking to dominate local firefights, zip across the map, or copy someone's outfit on the fly, m2 puts full power right at your fingertips.

---

🔥 Feature Breakdown

• 🎯 Precision Combat Suite: Dominate your aim with a fully customizable Aimbot featuring smooth tracking, wall checks, hit-part selection, and team filtering. Pair it with an instant Triggerbot to automatically fire the exact millisecond an enemy crosses your crosshair.

• 👁️ Dynamic FOV & Visual ESP: Keep full situational awareness with customizable Enemy Highlights and an overlay FOV Circle. Switch between high-visibility color presets or turn on full Rainbow RGB mode to suit your style.

• 🚀 Movement & Stat Overrides: Break the game's limits by adjusting your WalkSpeed and JumpPower on the fly, or activate the built-in Fly System to hover above the action.

• 🌐 Server & Player Utilities: Select any player in the server using the dynamic dropdown to Teleport directly to their position or Clone their Avatar instantly. CLONE DOES NOT WORK ATM

• ⚙️ Rayfield Integration & Security: Powered by Rayfield's modern design—complete with built-in Key System, dynamic Theme Selector, Discord integration, and automatic Config Saving so your setup is always ready when you execute.

---

> 💡 Get Started: Run the script, enter your key, press LeftControl to toggle the menu, and take over the game.
